pro_course_detail.title: Interview Preparation (expertise in U.S. Government Jobs)
pro_course_detail.description:
Hi there! 

Whether you have a job interview in the government or in the private sector, I can support you to BE your best. I highlight the word BE because I believe the key to a successful interview is feeling confident and at ease, so that your authentic self and capabilities naturally come through.  

I worked eight years as a spokesperson for a U.S.government agency. I was interviewed hundreds of times for radio/TV shows and newspapers.  Looking back, it is hard to believe.  I am naturally an introvert and in my early professional years I could not sleep the night before a presentation. I took many trainings and learned many cognitive skills to cope with my nervousness.  However, what really helped me was learning about how the nervous systems works and simple, yet potent, practices to stay present in my body while connecting to others. 

In addition, I have interviewed hundreds of potential job candidates for U.S government positions.  The majority of the candidates I recommended were hired successfully.  I have a gift for aligning the right candidate with the right manager.  

I look forward to sharing my experience with you.   Here are some of the services I offer: 

•	Create customized interview questions based on your resume and the job description.  (If you would like me to create customized interview questions, please send me your resume and job description in advance.) 

•	Conduct a practice interview during which I will give you feedback on how to communicate verbally and non-verbally in a clear and confident manner.   

•	Enhance your vocabulary with Business English expressions.

•	Provide suggestions on how to answer "tricky" questions and what to ask. 

•	Help  you identify strengths that might not be apparent to you.  

•	Help you explore if the job is aligned with your experience, values, and goals.

•	Introduce you to some practices that will help you minimize your normal nervousness by staying connected to your body and the environment.

pro_course_detail.title: Preparación para entrevistas (experta en empleos del gobierno de Estados Unidos)
pro_course_detail.description:
¡Saludos! 
Si tiene una entrevista de trabajo ya sea con el sector privado o con el gobierno de los Estados  puedo ayudarle a SER lo mejor posible. Destaco la palabra SER porque creo que la clave del éxito de una entrevista es sentirse seguro y cómodo, para que su auténtico yo y sus capacidades se expresen de forma natural.  

Trabajé ocho años como portavoz de una agencia del gobierno de los Estados Unidos. Me entrevistaron cientos de veces para programas de radio, televisión y periódicos.  Mirando atrás, es difícil de creer.  Soy introvertida por naturaleza y en mis primeros años profesionales no podía dormir la noche anterior a una presentación. Tomé muchos cursos de formación y aprendí muchas habilidades cognitivas para hacer frente a mi nerviosismo.  Sin embargo, lo que realmente me ayudó fue aprender cómo funciona el sistema nervioso y prácticas sencillas, pero potentes, para mantenerme presente en mi cuerpo mientras conectaba con los demás. 

Además, he entrevistado a cientos de candidatos para puestos en el gobierno de los Estados Unidos.  La mayoría de los que recomendé  fueron contratados.  

Deseo compartir mi experiencia con usted.  A continuación describo algunos de los servicios que puedo ofrecerle: 
•	Crear preguntas personalizadas con base en su resume y la descripción del trabajo. (Si desea que prepare preguntas personalizadas, por favor envíeme estos documentos con anticipación.)  
•	Hacer una simulación de entrevista en la que le daré sugerencias sobre como comunicarse de manera verbal y no verbal en un modo claro y con confianza. 
•	Compartir expresiones usadas en el Español  para negocios. 
•	Proveerle sugerencias sobre cómo responder a preguntas difíciles.
•	Identificar fortalezas de las cuales quizás no se haya percatado.
•	Ayudarle a explorar si el trabajo se ajusta a su experiencia, valores y metas. 
•	Compartir algunas práctica que le ayudarán a minimizar su nerviosismo normal al mantenerse conectado con su cuerpo y ambiente.

I help you believe in yourself and your potential. By showing exercises to overcome your fears and doubts. We will discuss your achievements and how to explain them in an organized manner.

Behavioral Interview Questions 
Behavioral interview questions delve into how candidates handled past situations to learn about their ability to perform in a position. 
These are the type of questions that start with something like, "Give me an example of..." or "Tell me about a time...." or “Describe an occasion when….” or “Outline a situation….” A popular behavioral question is, “Give me an example of when you had to deal with a difficult customer.” .

The STAR Method
The STAR interview method is a technique you can use to prepare for behavioral and situational interview questions. STAR stands for: situation, task, action and result. This method will help you prepare clear and concise responses using real-life examples.

Online Interview Preparation 
Review standard video interviewing etiquette
Explore video interview preparation tips
Go over potential video interview questions

Resume Writing 
Your resume is like a menu—it shows employers what you have to offer. And just like a menu is broken into clear categories to make ordering easier on a diner, resume sections make it quicker for busy hiring managers to see if you've got what what they're looking for.

course_info.trial_description:

I have experience in Linguistics and learning languages which allows me to understand how to pronounce words and phrases. This will be done through mimicking speech. You will read along with me and follow my intonation. We will focus on the flow, the emphasis, and most importantly the way an American speaker would say it. Only through copying will you be able to feel the way an American speaks. I prefer the theory of accent acquisition rather than accent reduction. This is because it is impossible to forget our mother language. With this idea in mind, it is better to think of it as adding another accent into your arsenal. This way, you will be able to utilize the accent according to the language.

Speaking: Oftentimes when having a conversation with someone we do not think about our pronunciation. It is good to not think too much about it, but it is even better if one does not need to think about it while at the same time have great pronunciation. The way a native speaker speaks is not the it is written.

Reading: When reading aloud in English, we have certain rhythms and pauses that occur. We also connect words and drop sounds. Each language has their own unique cadence, and here we will attempt accustom your to English.

As a philosopher, it is my job to ask interesting questions, and so I am a perfect teacher for those who are bored of the basic "how is the weather?" conversations. Contact me if you want to learn to share ideas in another language, and articulate complex points of view in speech or review your writing. We can talk about art or science or religion or history, or anything that interests you! If you can't think of anything, don't worry, I will. I have 12 years of experience in postsecondary education, with degrees in Linguistics, Religious Studies, and Philosophy. I've learned 6 languages (including Elvish and Old English, which iTalki does not show!) studied abroad in 3 different countries, and have officially taught English as a Second Language to students from around the world. I would be an excellent teacher for someone who would like to learn how to speak or write English in an academic setting.

My courses focus not just on English language skills, but critical thinking skills that lay a foundation for higher level work in almost any profession or specialization. By learning to read and analyze arguments with me, you can sharpen your own clarity of expression. By discussing your ideas, you can deepen your ability to express your thinking in English. I also offer writing coaching to help you with whatever other projects you're work on - whether it's blogging, journal articles, dissertations, or novels! In addition to my academic training, I have a lot of experience in creative writing.

pro_course_detail.title: Academic Writing, Personal Statements, Grant application
pro_course_detail.description:
The secret to good writing is that it is closely linked to good thinking. As a professional philosopher, this is one of my special talents. I will help you bring logical clarity and coherence to your writing, as well as nuance and style, in order to best help you articulate your ideas.  The course can serve you in a number of ways:

1) Work on a personal statement, grant application, book proposal, or conference presentation. If you want to persuade someone of the importance of your project, your career, or your candidacy for an academic program, its worth taking the extra time to make the best case possible. Especially if the words count are limited, you will need to say a lot in a little space: let me help you structure your thinking!

2) If you are a high school, university, or graduate-level researcher, I can help you with every stage of the writing process, from brainstorming to bibliography. 
In particular, you will learn:
-Brainstorming tactics and thesis formation
-Introductory hook
-Paragraph structure, coherence of ideas
-Writing style and grammar
-Citing sources: footnotes, paraphrasing, bibliographies

3) Other: blogging, diplomatic emails, personal reflections, advertising content (philosophers have a knack for persuasion!), or even creative writing. I can help you improve style, grammar, or content, or guide you in communicating across cultural nuances.

pro_course_detail.title: Independent Study in Philosophy
pro_course_detail.description:
Learn English by taking a one-on-one course in Philosophy with a university professor. Let's talk and read about the big questions together: 

What is philosophy, and what does it mean to love wisdom?
What is truth and how can we distinguish truth from falsity in a "post-truth" world? 
What is art and how can we understand its place in a world so dominated by scientific thinking? 
How can we understand our roles as individuals within a larger community?
How can we determine if something is good or evil? 
What or who is God, and why do people believe in his existence, or not? 
What is phenomenology? 

These are just a few of the questions past students have been interested in. Together, we can plan a reading list and set of questions that meet your interests and needs.

pro_course_detail.title: Attacking Faulty Reasoning, Logic, Fallacies
pro_course_detail.description:
This class is a more philosophical approach to critical thinking. Improve your logic and critical thinking through one of two methods:
(1) Learn to slowly and carefully read philosophical texts that discuss these issues. through how to improve critical thinking through particular texts. We will begin with Platonic dialogues. 
(2) Work through a textbook of Informal Logic, which will train you to think more clearly by training you to recognize and eliminate common patterns of errors, or logical fallacies. We will use Damer's "Attacking Faulty Reasoning" (6th or 7th edition).

pro_course_detail.title: Introduction: Choosing a Learning Strategy

For your initial lesson, feel free to sign up for a half-hour strategy session. We can talk about your language learning goals, and how I can best help you achieve them through my course offerings. (Please note that I do not offer hour-long courses for first-lessons.)

Note: you may also book this course again for your first full lesson (of 30 minutes or 1 hour). With a lower trial rate, you can have a stress-free experience of what a lesson with me is like to help you better decide if it is a good fit for your learning needs.

pro_course_detail.title: Classic Texts:  What is Freedom?
pro_course_detail.description:
What is Freedom? This idea is central to human life, and it is of course a major part of the "American dream." But what does this word mean? Is freedom about external circumstance, or internal state? And how has it so shaped our popular imagination? This course will give you a mini-version of what we call in English a "great-books" course: an introduction to classic texts that have shaped the history and culture of the anglophone world, in America and beyond. 

*READING*: Each session will feature a selection of works from a variety of genres and from across different periods, to improve your range of literary comprehension and to give you new angles to think from - from literature to poetry to political philosophy.*

*WRITING*: Each session will include an assignment of a short response paragraph to the readings to work on your writing skills.

*SPEAKING*: Each session, come with questions or reflections, and we can work out these themes together, as you expand your English and learn to think about big ideas!

[*Too busy to write? Too busy to read? That's ok! The advantage of one-on-one tutoring is that we can adapt to your needs and schedule.]

Let's work on polishing your English skills while reflecting on important themes together!
